title: fix(scripts): check-readme-exports names its population as TRACKED, plus the scripts/ population census
body:
Fixes #6545

## What this is

The card's graded remedy — *"make the population explicit in the gates' output"* — was **already in place on the two gates the card named**, and had been since the commits that introduced them. So this PR is the other half the grading required: **the census across `scripts/`**, plus the one gap it found.

### The stale premise, measured

| gate | verdict line says `tracked`? | since |
|---|---|---|
| `check-control-bytes` | yes — `scanned N tracked text file(s)` | `7c9a4e5e3`, 2026-08-05 (the commit that introduced it) |
| `check-vi-mock-specifiers` | yes — `N tracked source file(s)` | `e9e55524e`, 2026-08-25 (the commit that introduced it) |

Neither file has been touched since the card was filed (2026-08-26 10:09Z) — `git log --since` on both paths is empty. That is why the card's own evidence block already quotes `tracked` in both outputs: option 1 was satisfied before it was written.

## The census

Framed as the card's real question — *can this gate be asked about a file it will not open, and does its output admit that?* — rather than a grep for `git ls-files`.

**Nine `scripts/` files shell out to git. Four use `git ls-files` as their judged population:**

| gate | population named in the verdict? |
|---|---|
| `check-control-bytes` | yes — `N tracked text file(s)` |
| `check-vi-mock-specifiers` | yes — `N tracked source file(s)` |
| `check-vi-mock-inherit` | yes — `N tracked source file(s)` |
| `check-readme-exports` | **no** — `N README(s) under packages/`, a claim about the directory |

**Not in the population question, and why:**

- `check-changeset-presence` — already solved in the opposite direction: it runs `git ls-files --others --exclude-standard` over `.changeset/*.md` **specifically to see untracked changesets**, so that writing one and running the gate before staging is not a false red. Documented in the script: *"Empty in CI, where the checkout has no untracked files."* Prior art for widening a population where the gate is asking "did you write X".
- `check-skills-paths` — reads the directory, not `git ls-files`, and says so in its own docstring. Untracked files are inside its population.
- `pm/check-half-states` — uses `git ls-files` as a *validation oracle* for path tokens, not as a scan population. An unverifiable token is dropped by design, so the index under-reports rather than invents.
- The commit-range family (`check-changeset-presence`, `check-i18n-en-drift`, `check-changeset-overwrite`, `check-governed-queue-guard`) has a sibling population question — a range cannot see an uncommitted edit — and both gates that print a census already name it: `Compared the working tree with SHA (merge-base with origin/main)` and `No en value changed in this range`.
- The ~26 gates that walk the filesystem (`readdirSync` / glob) have the inverse exposure, not this one: they see untracked files.

## The one gap, and the fix

`check-readme-exports` walks `git ls-files -- packages/` twice (READMEs, and package manifests) but reported `43 README(s) under packages/`. That phrasing is a filesystem claim, and as a filesystem claim it is false the moment an author writes a new README and has not staged it.

Measured on this branch — planting a real, untracked `packages/census-probe-pkg/README.md` and `package.json`, then reading the gate's own census through its exported `scan()`:

```
RUN 1  clean worktree              readmes=43 packages=40
       verdict: 43 README(s) under packages/ (0 outside any package), 407 fenced block(s) ...

RUN 2  untracked README on disk    readmes=43 packages=40
       verdict: 43 README(s) under packages/ (0 outside any package), 407 fenced block(s) ...
```

Byte-identical. The gate was green about a `README.md` sitting under `packages/` that it never opened.

**The change is the sentence, not the population:** the verdict now reads `43 tracked README(s) under packages/` and `... of 40 tracked package(s)`. Same walk, same counts, same exit codes. Plus a header section stating the blind spot, and the matching correction in `content/docs/guide/ci-cd-pipeline.md`, which also said "for every `README.md` under `packages/`".

## ⛔ Options 2 and 3 are not here

Widening the population to untracked files, or refusing to run on a dirty worktree, change what these gates mean. The census did **not** make either look right: the one gate where widening is genuinely correct (`check-changeset-presence`) already does it, deliberately and locally. No recommendation to escalate.

## Tests

Union run on `728ddacb2`, the branch head.

- `pnpm exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 scripts/__tests__/` — **90 files, 2573 tests passed**. The whole tree, not just the gate's own file: `content/docs/guide/ci-cd-pipeline.md` is pinned by `ci-cd-pipeline-doc.test.ts`, `doc-version-claims`, `lint-workflow`, `merge-queue-reporting`, `dependabot-merge-gate`, `check-action-forward-parity`, `quick-reference-current-release-4143` and `scripts-type-check`.
- Gates, each read from its own verdict line, exit code captured before any pipe: `check:control-bytes`, `check:entry-guard`, `check:doc-fences`, `check:vi-mock-specifiers`, `check:vi-mock-inherit`, `check:shell-escape-residue`, `check:skills-paths`, `check:changeset-presence`, `check:changeset-fixed`, `check:changeset-no-major`, `check:changeset-overwrite` — all `exit=0`.
- `pnpm run type-check:scripts` — exit 0, and `tsc --listFiles` confirms the edited test file is one of the 153 files in that program (not excluded).
- `eslint --no-inline-config --format json` on the two changed JS/TS files — 0 errors, 0 warnings. Narrowed, and the narrowing is measured: the file count is eslint's own (`--format json`, 2 records); the markdown file is reported by eslint itself as outside its population (*"File ignored because no matching configuration was supplied"*), so it is covered by `check:doc-fences` instead; and `eslint.config.js` declares no `parserOptions.project` / `projectService`, so with type-aware linting off this diff cannot move the verdict on any file it does not touch.

**Reverse verification of the new pin** — predicted direction RED, and RED is what happened. Reverting only the two wording changes in the committed `scripts/check-readme-exports.mjs` (mutation confirmed on disk: removed-text count 0, blob `eea2eacd` vs HEAD `19fe5855`, re-confirmed still mutated *after* the run) fails **exactly one** test:

```
× names that population as TRACKED, so a green is not read as a claim about the directory (objectui#6545)
  AssertionError: expected '0 README(s) under packages/ (0 outsid...' to contain 'tracked README(s) under packages/'
  Test Files  1 failed (1) · Tests  1 failed | 46 passed (47)
```

The pre-existing census-shape pin stays green, which is correct — it pins the shape, not the population word. Restore leg proven by blob equality with `HEAD` (`19fe5855`) plus an empty `git diff HEAD` and empty `git status --porcelain`, not by an exit code. No build is involved: the test imports the `.mjs` source directly, so there is no `dist/` that could serve a stale copy.

A first attempt at this ablation was **void** and is reported as such: the setup shell's `EXIT` trap restored the file when that call ended, so the following call measured the unmutated tree and reported a green that looked like a passing ablation. Redone with mutation, run, and both proofs inside one invocation.

Changeset: `.changeset/6545-gate-population-census.md`, empty frontmatter — no package source, no published contract, no runtime behaviour changes.
